textContent:
When the Creator is about to say "Ofc I do" to the media. Just before that we will also have some fast-flash scenes of A and Creator's first conversation! When they are talking about B and C their friends:
Creator: I just hope they are here with me at least in some universe where we could achieve our dream together. (while crying)
To which A replies with a very straight face:
A: Ofc they are! I can sense them sitting just beside you!
(Cut to final scene) simultaneously.. Creator's reply: "Ofc I do"
